avis.titre: Great Product. Just what it says.Great Product. Just what it says.
avis.texte: I'm a huge Paula's Choice fan and this is one of 3 products I bought for my husband to try. They are essentially other products from her line, repackaged for men. This sunscreen has not irritated his skin and we have seen a noticeable improvement using all 3 products. I've purchased it from both Amazon and directly from the manufacturer. Love the convenience of amazon.

The best skin product I have ever used. It does not leave your skin feeling oily and their is no shine to it. It smells like syrup when you put it on lol, but once it is on it reacts with your skin and dries up very quickly and the smell is gone. The rest of the day it leaves your skin moisturized. I would say it lasts about 16 hours. I would wash it off and reapply if you’re going out that night. It also has a verrrrrrrryyy small feeling of stickiness to it, which I prefer over the greasy feeling that most moisturizers leave on my skin. It is not so sticky that anyone would be able to notice to though.

avis.titre: Great product for exactly what is it, moisturizer and sunscreen!
avis.texte: Looks, I read some of the bad reviews on this product and they clearly don't know what they're buying. This product works great. It's a combination moisturizer and sunscreen for men. I've used high-end brands that cost more than this and I actually like this product much better. It provides the perfect amount of moisture for my skin and great UV protection. I actually put it on daily but even when I go to the beach for a full day, I haven't gotten burned on my face. I've bought this multiple times and will continue to buy it for my daily routine.
Diluted water white substance. It’s A sunscreen. Not a moisturizer. Overpriced and bad smell. It has no effect other than as a sunscreen.

avis.titre: NOTE THE PRODUCT SIZE!!! LOVE THIS PRODUCT
avis.texte: I remember getting this in the mail and seeing its size I was disappointed but then I saw the value of the product and how much it helped clear up my face! Love this stuff

This product works great on the face. Originally I was hesitant in using it because I hate the feeling of any liquids on my face especially sunscreen, but this item is very subtle. You put a generous drop on the finger and rub it on your face and it will feel moisturized but without the feeling of liquid on your face. There is a small hint of the sunscreen smell but after a week of use you will ignore it. Amazing product. Have been using it for 3 years now and have never used anything else!

avis.texte: My boyfriend loves this lotion. Says it doesn't feel greasy. His biggest complaint against most lotions and/or sunscreen is that when he works out they run and get into his eyes. Says this lotion does not do that.
